column1: # Trust escapes in rivet's proofs: every statement a prover accepts
# without checking it. tools/ci/trust-ledger.py regenerates the source rows
# (`scan`) and compares them with this file (`check`); the Rocq Proofs job
# compares the kernel rows with `coqchk -o` over every compiled .vo.
# A new escape fails CI until it is added here, with its reason in the
# source next to it. Removing an escape needs no edit here first.
